text:
We checked “Test-Basic-File-Template Folder” and found 2 issues in the InDesign file that are likely causing the problems in Frontify, plus 1 that may change how it looks. Here’s what to change:

Likely causing the problems

1. Font missing from the package
Frontify needs the font files to render the text, otherwise the template falls back to another font.
Where: the font “Public Sans”
• Make sure the font is installed or activated on your computer.
• Package again with File > Package with "Copy Fonts" checked, and zip the whole folder, including "Document fonts".
Learn more

2. Linked image missing from the package
The document links to an image that isn’t in the package, so Frontify can’t show it.
Where: the image “ECU-AUS-Logo_CMYK.pdf” (page 1)
• Relink any missing images in Window > Links.
• Package again with File > Package with "Copy Linked Graphics" checked.
Learn more

May change how it looks

3. Paragraph Composer used
The Adobe Paragraph Composer breaks lines differently from browsers, so text may reflow in Frontify.
Where: paragraph styles “Paragraph Style 1”, “Paragraph Style 2” and “Paragraph Style 3”, used on page 1
• In the paragraph style, go to Justification and set Composer to Adobe Single-line Composer.
Learn more

Once that’s done, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
